summary: we decide do devlop a game for children to spark their curiosity about space and help them realise how complex a space mission is : from the choice of your spaceship and it's speed, fuel capacity to go to the planet that you want to explore to the rocket launching and data collecting in space
details: on our project you chose a spaceship to explore space, at the beginning you only have a small space ship so you do a small mission, for example on the moon, on the moon you play a platformer to collect data that's represented by moon rocks and when you come back to earth, the more data you have, the more budget you will have for the next mission so you can buy bigger ship, more fuel and go explore new planets
